nodes.label: Taiwan AI Academy Award Group Photo Test Image
nodes.description: Wide (~2048x878) unannotated stage photograph used as the default inference input. About twenty-two people in a single row on an auditorium stage in front of a projection screen and beige curtain, most wearing yellow conference lanyards and badges. Two central figures hold a presentation board reading '佳作獎' (Honorable Mention Award) issued by 台灣人工智慧學校 (Taiwan AI Academy), captioned as a first-cohort technical leadership training programme project.
nodes.rationale: Reusing the author's own award photo as the shipped test image both avoids licensing concerns and provides a genuinely hard many-instance case.

nodes.label: Crowded Shoulder-to-Shoulder Instance Benchmark
nodes.description: The stress case this image encodes: ~22 same-class instances standing shoulder-to-shoulder in one horizontal band, mutually occluding at the torso, at nearly identical scale, in a very wide aspect ratio that must be letterboxed into a square network input. Success is measured by instance count and by whether non-maximum suppression merges adjacent people.
nodes.rationale: Many same-class, mutually occluding, uniform-scale instances in one band is structurally the same failure mode as a packed poultry pen, which is why this asset is a meaningful proxy despite the subject matter differing.
